title: Norway's GPFG ethics-framework committee delivers its report to the Ministry of Finance
source: EST: the committee's own official website, nettsteder.regjeringen.no/uerspu/ ('Utvalg som skal vurdere det etiske rammeverket for Statens pensjonsfond utland'), fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200 — note this subdomain is reachable while regjeringen.no itself returned a Cloudflare HTTP 403 to WebFetch and to curl with three browser user-agents on the same day). The site states the deadline verbatim: 'Utvalget skal levere sin rapport innen 15. oktober 2026.' It gives the committee's mandate as 'vurdere og foreslå eventuelle endringer i det etiske rammeverket og relevante deler av den ansvarlige forvaltningen av pensjonsfondet', its chair as Aslak Skancke, and its appointment as a royal resolution of 2025-11-07. Independently corroborated by the Storting's own Innst. 418 S (2025-2026) (stortinget.no, fetched direct 2026-09-06, HTTP 200), which records that 'et nedsatt utvalg legger frem innen 15. oktober 2026'. Filed estimate on three counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a Norwegian government-appointed committee's own site, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and the date is a stated delivery deadline for a report rather than a scheduled publication with a time
notes: Discovered during the norway-gpfg-bond-expert-group-2027-01-25 initial research (2026-09-06), which was mapping the dated nodes in Norway's GPFG governance calendar. This is the OTHER Ministry-commissioned review running in parallel with the bond-strategy work, and it is a different body from the Ekspertradet: a committee appointed by royal resolution 2025-11-07 under chair Aslak Skancke, reviewing the fund's ethical framework and the observation/exclusion guidelines, after the Ministry put temporary ethical guidelines in place. Filed at LOW impact with a deliberately thin channel stated honestly: the GPFG holds roughly 1.5% of all listed equities worldwide, including every name this calendar tracks, so an ethical-framework change is in principle a change to the exclusion criteria that govern that holder's participation in those names. But nothing in the committee's published mandate targets AI, semiconductors or US tech; the report goes out for consultation (horing) after delivery rather than taking effect on the date; and no primary this session read attaches any market channel to 2026-10-15. It is filed because it is DATED, primary-sourced and part of the same governance chain, not because a trade is implied - none is. Read alongside norway-gpfg-bond-expert-group-2027-01-25, which is the bond-side node in the same chain.
